retailStores.label: NIKE Direct and Converse retail stores
retailStores.definition: Number of NIKE Brand factory stores, in-line stores (including employee-only stores) and Converse stores operated by NIKE Direct and Converse (FY2026 10-K, U.S. and non-U.S. retail store tables).

footwearShare.label: Share of NIKE Brand footwear production
footwearShare.definition: Approximate share of total NIKE Brand footwear finished goods made by contract-manufacturer factories in the country. The 10-K names only the top three countries; factories are independent contractors, not Nike-owned.

apparelShare.label: Share of NIKE Brand apparel production
apparelShare.definition: Approximate share of total NIKE Brand apparel finished goods made by contract-manufacturer factories in the country (top three countries only).

longLivedAssets.label: Long-lived assets

notes: All figures are from the FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended May 31, 2026). Countries: production shares are for independent contract factories (the 10-K names only the top three countries for footwear and apparel; as of May 31, 2026 contract manufacturers ran 95 footwear factories in 11 countries and 321 apparel factories in 34 countries). Long-lived assets are given only for the U.S., the U.K., Belgium, China and 'Other'. Retail stores are given only as U.S. versus non-U.S. No employee count by state, country or region is in the 10-K, which gives approximately 73,000 employees worldwide; Nike's impact reports and online manufacturing map were not used. The headquarters is now named the Philip H. Knight Campus in the 10-K. Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.
